title: Give the claim sweep a return value describing what it did
action: sweep_expired_claims (handlers_select.rs:75) currently returns MR<()>, so everything it learns leaves only through log_decision (:141, :158) and one eprintln (:152), and the Unreachable arm prints nothing at all. Change the return type to carry three sets: the claims it released, the units it parked, and the units it could not reach in this store. Build them from the facts the function already has — the same values it writes into the decision rows at :141 and :158, and the SweepResetOutcome variants at :276. This cell changes the RETURN TYPE ONLY: the release criteria, the heartbeat-then-gate ordering, the under-gate re-judgement at :103-118, and every lock the function takes stay byte-equivalent in behavior. Migrate the two production call sites (handlers_select.rs:620 for claim-next and status_full/orient.rs:271 inside sweep_on_orient) and the 13 test call sites in verbs/cells/tests.rs (2045 through 2549). orient.rs must keep its observable behavior identical — it may now have the sets available but this cell does not change a single line of what orient prints; that belongs to srd-2's sibling work. Judge existing coverage first: the sweep tests in verbs/cells/tests.rs already pin the release criteria, the parked verdict and the unreachable path; author only the gap, which is that the returned sets agree with the decision rows the same run logs.

truths: sweep_expired_claims returns the set of claims it released, the set of units it parked, and the set of units it could not reach

bee orient's observable output is byte-identical to before this cell

all 13 call sites migrated plus a new case asserting the returned sets match the logged decision rows
